item.title: Innovative Eyewear shares soar after partnering with HTC to bring VIVE Eagle smart glasses to the US
item.summary: Innovative Eyewear shares soared in US trade on Monday after announcing a strategic alliance with HTC, the Taiwanese electronics manufacturer, to sell its VIVE Eagle smart eyewear range to American customers. Under the deal, Innovative will offer the VIVE Eagle line through its Lucyd.co web store from September 2026.
